meta.title: Heng Auto Service – Service & reviews
meta.description: Servicing, repairs and diagnostics for every make, with a clear quote before any work starts. Read real customer reviews.

fixed.title: Fixed right the first time
fixed.text: Servicing, repairs and diagnostics for every make, with a clear quote before any work starts.

brakes.title: Brakes that stop like new
brakes.text: We measure your pads and discs, show you what’s worn, and replace only what needs it.

ac.title: Cold A/C on the hottest day
ac.text: Leak test, gas recharge and a fresh cabin filter, usually done while you wait.

diag.title: A warning light came on?
diag.text: Our computer scan finds the cause in under an hour, and you get a written report.

services.title: What we fix, and how
services.intro: Every service starts with the problem you notice. We show you the worn part and give you a quote before any work begins.

oil.name: Oil & filter
oil.short: Fresh oil and filter to keep your engine smooth and quiet.

brakes.name: Brakes
brakes.short: For squealing, grinding, or a soft brake pedal.
signs: Squealing or grinding when you brake
Car pulls to one side when stopping
steps: Replace pads or discs as needed
Bleed and refresh the brake fluid

engine.name: Engine
engine.short: For warning lights, rough idling, or lost power.
signs: Rough idle or shaking at stops
Loss of power when climbing or overtaking
steps: Check plugs, ignition, belts and cooling
Repair or replace the faulty parts
Re-scan to confirm the fault is gone

tires.name: Tires & alignment
tires.short: For drifting, shaking, or tires wearing unevenly.
signs: Car drifts left or right on a straight road
steps: Repair punctures or fit new tires
Set wheel alignment on our machine

ac.name: Air conditioning
ac.short: For warm air, weak airflow, or a musty smell.
signs: A/C blows warm or only cool, not cold
Clicking or rattling when A/C is on
steps: Clean the evaporator and check the compressor

electrical.name: Electrical
electrical.short: For flat batteries, slow starts, and flickering lights.
signs: Won’t start or slow to start
Windows, locks or gauges stop working
steps: Test the battery, alternator and starter
Replace the battery, fuse or failed part

body.name: Body & paint
body.short: For dents, scratches, rust, and accident damage.
signs: Dents from a bump or parking knock
steps: Pull out dents or replace the panel
Polish so the repair blends in

diag.name: Diagnostics
diag.short: Find the cause of a warning light or a strange noise.
signs: A warning light you don’t recognise
You want a check before buying a used car
steps: Quote any repair, with no pressure to book

general.short: A full check-up of everything that keeps you safe.
